name: Visualise Reflections
description: The specular (image source) reflection paths from the scene's sources to its receivers, by order, drawn in one colour per order (order 0 black). Outputs them as reflections, which Visualise Billiard plays. The Preview button shows or hides the drawing.

inputParameters.name: order
inputParameters.description: Reflection order(s) to draw, 0 for the direct sound; negative orders are left out. Empty (default): the first order.

inputParameters.name: source_idx
inputParameters.description: Index of the source, in the order of the scene's sources. Empty (default): every source.

inputParameters.name: receiver_idx
inputParameters.description: Index of the receiver, in the order of the scene's receivers. Empty (default): every receiver.

outputParameters.name: reflections
outputParameters.description: The specular reflections of the chosen orders and pair (a SpecularReflections, which is a ray field: connect it to Visualise Billiard to play them).

outputParameters.name: order
outputParameters.description: The reflection order of each path.

outputParameters.name: time
outputParameters.description: The travel time of each path in milliseconds.
